qa: You can give that effect to such Digimon, but if the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the gained effect won't trigger.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Blocker＞ [On Play] [When Digivolving] Give 1 of your opponent's Digimon "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks." until their turn ends. [All Turns] When this Digimon wins a battle, it may digivolve into [Callismon] or [Marsmon] in the hand without paying the cost.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, trash their top security card.
